MCC NEET Counselling Registration 2026: Your Essential Roadmap to Medical Admissions

The National Eligibility cum Entrance Test (NEET UG) is the gateway to a career in medicine and dentistry in India. After the rigorous examination, the next crucial step for aspiring doctors and dentists is the Medical Counselling Committee (MCC) NEET UG Counselling 2026. This process determines your admission to prestigious MBBS, BDS, and other medical courses across the nation. Understanding each stage of this complex process is vital for securing your dream seat.

Given the recent re-examination of NEET 2026 on June 21, 2026, the NEET UG 2026 results are now anticipated by July 2026. Consequently, the MCC NEET UG counselling registration is expected to commence tentatively in July 2026.

What is MCC NEET UG Counselling?

The Medical Counselling Committee (MCC), on behalf of the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), is the central authority responsible for conducting the NEET UG counselling. This centralized counselling facilitates admissions to:

✅ 15% All India Quota (AIQ) seats in Government Medical/Dental Colleges (excluding Jammu & Kashmir, as per the current framework).

✅ 100% seats in Deemed Universities.

✅ 100% seats in Central Universities (like DU, BHU, AMU).

✅ 100% seats in AIIMS, JIPMER, ESIC, and AFMC Institutes.

The remaining 85% of state quota seats are managed by individual state counselling authorities. It is important to note that eligible candidates can participate in both AIQ (MCC) and their respective State Quota counselling simultaneously.

NEET UG Counselling 2026: Expected Schedule

While the official dates will be announced on the MCC website (mcc.nic.in), based on previous trends and recent updates, here’s a tentative timeline for NEET UG Counselling 2026:

Event Tentative Dates (2026)
NEET UG 2026 Result Declaration July 2026
MCC Counselling Registration (Round 1) Start July 2026 (e.g., July 21, 2026)
Choice Filling & Locking (Round 1) Late July 2026
Seat Allotment Result (Round 1) Late July / Early August 2026
Reporting to Allotted College (Round 1) Early August 2026
Round 2 Registration & Choice Filling August 2026
Mop-Up Round August / September 2026
Stray Vacancy Round September / October 2026
Always refer to the official MCC website, mcc.nic.in, for the most accurate and updated schedule. Unofficial dates should not be relied upon for final planning.

Eligibility Criteria for MCC NEET UG Counselling 2026

To be eligible for MCC NEET UG 2026 Counselling, candidates must fulfill the following key criteria:

✅ Passed NEET UG 2026 with the prescribed cutoff percentile (50th for General, 40th for SC/ST/OBC, and 45th for PwD candidates).

✅ Registered on the official MCC website within the stipulated dates.

✅ Attained a minimum age of 17 years as of December 31, 2026.

✅ Hold Indian citizenship (no domicile restriction for AIQ seats).

✅ Satisfy course-specific eligibility criteria, including subject combinations and minimum marks in Class 12.

Step-by-Step MCC NEET UG Counselling Process

The counselling process involves several critical stages. Following them meticulously is crucial for successful admission.

1. Online Registration
Visit the official MCC portal (mcc.nic.in) once the registration window opens. Click on "New Registration" and enter your NEET UG 2026 roll number, date of birth, and other required personal and academic details. Create a strong password for future logins.
2. Payment of Counselling Fee & Security Deposit
After registration, you must pay a non-refundable registration fee and a refundable security deposit online. The amount varies based on the category and type of institution you are applying for.
Category Registration Fee (Non-refundable) Security Deposit (Refundable) Total Fee (Approx.)
AIQ & Central Universities (UR/EWS) ₹1,000 ₹10,000 ₹11,000
AIQ & Central Universities (SC/ST/OBC/PwD) ₹500 ₹5,000 ₹5,500
Deemed Universities (All Categories) ₹5,000 ₹2,00,000 ₹2,05,000
Note: If applying for both Government & Deemed Universities, only pay the higher fee (₹2,05,000). These fees are based on previous year trends, and the official 2026 amounts will be notified by MCC.
3. Choice Filling & Locking
This is arguably the most critical step. Select your preferred colleges and courses from the available list and arrange them in strict order of preference. It is advisable to fill as many choices as possible, including a mix of safe, moderate, and dream colleges. Once satisfied, you must lock your choices before the specified deadline. Unlocked choices will not be considered for seat allotment.
4. Seat Allotment Result
The MCC will release the seat allotment result on its official website based on your NEET rank, choices filled, category, and seat availability. Download your provisional allotment letter.
5. Reporting to Allotted College
If you are allotted a seat, you must report to the designated college within the given timeframe with all your original documents for verification and completion of admission formalities. Failure to report on time may lead to the cancellation of your allotted seat.
6. Upgradation (Optional)
Candidates who are not satisfied with their allotted seat in an earlier round can opt for upgradation in subsequent rounds. If a better seat is allotted, the previous one will be automatically canceled.

Documents Required for MCC NEET UG Counselling 2026

Keeping all necessary documents ready in advance is paramount for a smooth counselling process. Ensure you have originals and multiple sets of self-attested photocopies.

✅ NEET UG 2026 Admit Card

✅ NEET UG 2026 Result/Rank Letter/Scorecard

✅ Class 10 Certificate (for Date of Birth Proof)

✅ Class 12 Mark Sheet and Passing Certificate

✅ Eight Passport Size Photographs (matching the one affixed on the NEET application form)

✅ Identity Proof (Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Passport, Driving License, etc.)

✅ Provisional Seat Allotment Letter (issued by MCC)

✅ Category Certificate (SC/ST/OBC/EWS), if applicable, issued by a competent authority. OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) and EWS certificates must be current for the financial year 2025-26.

✅ PwD Certificate, if applicable.

✅ Domicile Certificate (primarily for State Quota Counselling)

✅ Migration Certificate

✅ Transfer Certificate (TC)

✅ Fee Payment Receipt

Crucial Tips for a Successful MCC NEET UG 2026 Counselling

Stay Updated and Vigilant
Regularly check the official MCC website (mcc.nic.in) for announcements, schedules, and any changes. Be wary of unofficial websites and rumors.
Strategic Choice Filling
Research colleges thoroughly, consider previous year cut-offs, and prioritize your choices wisely. Fill a wide range of colleges to maximize your chances, listing your most desired institutions at the top.
Document Preparedness
Ensure all documents are authentic, readily accessible, and in the correct format. Timely verification is key, and any discrepancies can lead to disqualification.
Understand Fee Structure
Familiarize yourself with the fee structure of various colleges before locking your choices, especially for deemed universities where fees are significantly higher.

The MCC NEET UG Counselling 2026 is a defining phase in your medical career. By staying informed, preparing meticulously, and navigating each step strategically, you can significantly enhance your chances of securing admission to a coveted MBBS or BDS program. Best of luck to all aspirants!
